description: A lab-local open redirect: the lab logout endpoint redirects to any URL in its next parameter without an allowlist, so a logged-in user can be sent to a phishing page.
impact: An attacker could redirect lab users to a phishing page after logout.
proof_of_concept: GET /lab/logout?next=https://lab.evil.test/ returns 302 Location: https://lab.evil.test/ after lab logout.
remediation: Allowlist redirect targets to lab-local hosts only.
steps_to_reproduce: Log out of the lab session
Observe the redirect to the external lab host
title: Open redirect in lab logout flow
